# Y.A.R.V. — Automated Rebalancing Vaults (HackMeridian 2026)

> Deposit-and-forget liquidity vaults for Stellar's concentrated-liquidity
> pools. A HackMeridian 2026 submission (Genesis track, Stellar Composed
> theme).

## What it is

Concentrated-liquidity (CL) pools on Stellar (Aquarius CL pools, Sushi V3)
pay fees only while price stays inside a tick band — positions must be
actively re-ranged or they earn zero and hold 100% of the losing token.
Y.A.R.V. vaults restore the deposit-and-forget LP pattern: deposit in one
transaction, receive a fungible share token, and a strategy contract
re-ranges the position inside strict on-chain policy limits (oracle-
referenced slippage bounds, loss caps, cooldowns, venue allowlists).

## Architecture

- `cl_aquarius` — the first concentrated-liquidity strategy implementing
  `DeFindexStrategyTrait`: oracle-valued `balance()` in USDC, keeper
  `harvest` for claim-fees / convert-rewards / re-range via validated
  swap plans, pro-rata `withdraw`, `emergency_exit`.
- `strategy_registry` + `platform` — template-hash governance, curated
  venues, vaults created non-upgradable with `vault_fee = 0`; the only
  fee is a capped strategy-side cut of collected income.
- DeFindex vault + factory — OtterSec-audited custody/share layer, run
  under our own factory instance with a two-item correctness patch
  (carried-loss overwrite, delivered-vs-requested withdrawal check).
- Reflector oracle — every price decision references the oracle, never
  the pool's own spot.

## Live

Contracts are deployed and exercised on Stellar testnet — see
`DEPLOYMENTS.md` in the repository for the full address table and
verification transactions. This site is the vault UI: connect a testnet
wallet (Freighter) to deposit/withdraw and watch keeper rebalances.
